capabilities: Apply appearance presets and profiles to Obsidian and supported plugin interfaces
Restyle Kanban columns, cards, board backgrounds and drag states
Adjust flashcard, review control and button appearance in Spaced Repetition
Style Bases tables and cards, Tasks rows, Dataview tables, Calendar and Day Planner
Create, duplicate, import and export profiles with global and module-scoped custom CSS
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet editor; it applies its own styles to Obsidian and supported plugin interfaces through switchable profiles.
extras: Selectors were inspected against pinned plugin versions and the README states no live Obsidian vault or installed target plugins were used for validation. No account, paid feature or backend; an optional Buy Me a Coffee link is the only support path.
problem: Themes and Obsidian's own appearance settings do not reach the interfaces of Kanban, Spaced Repetition, Bases, Tasks, Dataview, Calendar and Day Planner, and editing those plugins directly is invasive.

relations.evidence: Column/card colors and opacity, automatic and manual column coloring, spacing, padding, radii, column blur
Flashcard appearance, shared question/answer typography, review controls, answer/review button colors and states
Table and cards-view settings using documented native Bases CSS variables.
Query row spacing and dividers, group headings, date metadata chips, and edit form section spacing.
Standard result-table padding, text size, headers, alternating rows and borders, list spacing
Calendar text size and outer spacing, today/day/heading/dot colors, and an optional weekend surface.
Timeline background and hour separators, time-block font, corner radius, inner content spacing, and shadow.

requires.name: Kanban, Spaced Repetition, Bases, Tasks, Dataview, Calendar, Day Planner

summary: Profile-based appearance customizer that restyles Obsidian and supported plugin interfaces with presets and scoped CSS.
